{{unknown name}} [[File:Forces of Nature Therian Forme Adventures.png|250px|thumb|Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus in their Therian Forme in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] The '''[[forces of nature]]''' are a [[Legendary trio|trio]] of [[Legendary Pokémon]] in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Tornadus== {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Flying |ball=None |nickname=Tornadus |jnickname=トルネロス |tmnickname=Tornelos |image=[[File:Team Plasma Tornadus Adventures.png|200px]]
Tornadus
[[File:Team Plasma Tornadus Therian Forme Adventures.png|200px]] |caption=Tornadus in Therian Forme |caught=yes |location=[[Unova]] |gender=Male{{p|Tornadus}} is a [[Gender|male]] exclusive Pokémon species. |ability={{a|Prankster}} (Incarnate Forme) |epnum=PS490 |epname=A Stormy Time in the Battle Subway |prevonum=641 |noevo=incap |released=yes |releaseep=PS547 |releasename=The Final Battle |current=[[Unova]] |media=special |va=no }} '''Tornadus''' (Japanese: '''トルネロス''' ''Tornelos'') was the second of the forces of nature to appear. ===History=== ===={{MangaArc|Black & White}}==== Tornadus first appeared in ''[[PS490|A Stormy Time in the Battle Subway]]''. He fought {{p|Thundurus}} in a field the [[Battle Subway]] train happened to be passing by. The intense weather created from the battle activated the train's emergency stop system, forcing it to wait until the weather cleared up. {{adv|White}}, not wanting the train and field to be damaged during the battle, decided to step in and stop the two {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, but her lack of skill as a Trainer prevented her from doing damage to either. [[Shauntal]] stepped in and attack the two with her {{p|Jellicent}}, but only succeed in enraging Tornadus and Thundurus further. Shauntal reveals that her intention was to provoke the two so that {{p|Landorus}} would be forced to appear and stop Tornadus and Thundurus from fighting. As Landorus takes Tornadus and Thundurus away, the three Pokémon are captured by [[Giallo]]. Giallo later gave the forces of nature to the [[Shadow Triad]] to aid in their mission to steal the [[Dark Stone]] from the {{DL|Nacrene City|Nacrene Museum}}. During the mission, the Shadow Triad face the [[Unova]] [[Gym Leader]]s in battle, but are eventually defeated. Not willing to give up, the Shadow Triad summon Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus and have them trap the Gym Leaders in a vortex of their respective elements. Though they won the battle, the vortex accidentally destroyed the door to the safe house where the Dark Stone was held. After their attempt to forcefully open the safe house's door fails, the Shadow Triad have the forces of nature take the captured Gym Leaders to [[N's Castle]]. The forces of nature were [[PS519|later]] given to [[Colress]] in order to figure out how to change them into their {{form|Forces of nature|Therian Formes}}. In ''[[PS520|Cold Hard Truth]]'', Colress, disguised as Hood Man, sends out Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus to battle against the Unova [[Elite Four]]. During the battle, Shauntal battles against Tornadus with her {{p|Golurk}}. Though he fails in transforming the forces of nature into their Therian Formes, Colress discovers the secret to their Forme Change is mirrors and sets out to find the [[Reveal Glass|correct mirror]]. ===={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}==== [[File:Swords of Justice vs Shadow Triad Adventures.png|thumb|200px|left|Tornadus battling the Swords of Justice]] [[PS532|Two years later]], {{adv|Blake}}, hearing that strange winds were reported on {{rt|20|Unova}}, went there to investigate. Shortly after arriving, Tornadus appeared before him and transformed into its Therian Forme. Recognizing Tornadus's strength, Blake sends out [[Kelden]] to battle alongside {{TP|Blake|Dewott}}. Kelden and Dewott's combination attacks overwhelm Tornadus, but it begins ignoring them to go after Giallo, who had rejected the decision to make Colress the new leader of [[Team Plasma]]. Tornadus grabs Giallo and attempts to take him away, but is soon {{status|freeze|frozen}} by Kelden's attacks. With Tornadus defeated, the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s controlling him [[recall]] Tornadus and retreat. In ''[[PS538|Therian Forme III]]'', Colress sent out Tornadus to battle against Blake at [[Driftveil City]]. Tornadus blocked Blake's Dewott's attacks, allowing Colress to run away with a captured [[Zinzolin]]. Not wanting to let his targets get away, Blake had Dewott battle against Tornadus while he chased after Colress. [[PS541|Soon after]], Tornadus defeated the Discipline Pokémon. In ''[[PS545|Deduction Time]]'', Tornadus is sent out by the Shadow Triad alongside Thundurus and Landorus to fight the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}. In ''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]'', the Reveal Glass was broken by Kelden, transforming it back into its Incarnate Forme. The Swords of Justice used this chance to defeat the forces of nature and the Shadow Triad, freeing the Legendary trio from Team Plasma's control and allowing them to escape. ===Personality and characteristics=== Tornadus is a powerful {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, holding his own against other {{pkmn2|Legendary}} and [[Mythical Pokémon]] like {{p|Thundurus}} and [[Kelden]]. In its Therian Forme, Tornadus is incredibly fast, and was stated by {{adv|Blake}} that {{TP|Blake|Genesect}}'s High-Speed Flight Form was inferior to the Cyclone Pokémon's speed. Rough weather typically accompanies Tornadus and he is said to never stay in the same place for more than five minutes. He has a strong rivalry with Thundurus, as the two battle so often it is common knowledge that {{p|Landorus}} is constantly restraining them from fighting. ===Moves used=== ====Therian Forme==== {{anmov/h|Flying||Team Plasma Tornadus Air Slash Therian Forme Adventures.png|Using Air Slash}} {{anmov|Flying|Air Slash|PS532|Legendary Tornadus}} {{anmov/f|Flying}} ==Thundurus== {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Electric |type2=Flying |ball=None |nickname=Thundurus |jnickname=ボルトロス |tmnickname=Voltolos |image=[[File:Team Plasma Thundurus Adventures.png|200px]]
Thundurus

The incident inspired Elesa to try and capture Thundurus, as she wished to become an {{type|Electric}} expert. Thundurus first appeared in ''[[PS484|Battle on a Roller Coaster]]'', where {{adv|Black}} encountered him outside the [[Nimbasa Gym]]. Due to a malfunction at the [[Gym]]'s roller coaster, Black was trapped inside a roller coaster car and was taken outside, where he encountered the Bolt Strike Pokémon, who proceeded to shock Black with electricity and disappear. Though injured from the experience, Black was freed from the car. In ''[[PS490|A Stormy Time in the Battle Subway]]'', Thundurus fought {{p|Tornadus}} in a field the [[Battle Subway]] train happened to be passing by. The intense weather created from the battle activated the train's emergency stop system, forcing it to wait until the weather cleared up. {{adv|White}}, not wanting the train and field to be damaged during the battle, decided to step in and stop the two {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, but her lack of skill as a Trainer prevented her from doing damage to either. [[Shauntal]] stepped in and attack the two with her {{p|Jellicent}}, but only succeed in enraging Thundurus and Tornadus further. Shauntal reveals that her intention was to provoke the two so that {{p|Landorus}} would be forced to appear and stop Thundurus and Tornadus from fighting. As Landorus takes Thundurus and Tornadus away, the three Pokémon are captured by [[Giallo]]. Giallo later gave the forces of nature to the [[Shadow Triad]] to aid in their mission to steal the [[Dark Stone]] from the {{DL|Nacrene City|Nacrene Museum}}. During the mission, the Shadow Triad face the [[Unova]] [[Gym Leader]]s in battle, but are eventually defeated. In ''[[PS520|Cold Hard Truth]]'', Colress, disguised as Hood Man, sends out Thundurus, Tornadus, and Landorus to battle against the Unova [[Elite Four]]. During the battle, [[Caitlin]] battles against Thundurus with her {{p|Gothitelle}}. Though he fails in transforming the forces of nature into their Therian Formes, Colress discovers the secret to their Forme Change is mirrors and sets out to find the [[Reveal Glass|correct mirror]]. ===={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}==== [[File:Swords of Justice vs Shadow Triad Adventures.png|thumb|200px|left|Thundurus battling the Swords of Justice]] [[PS537|Two years later]], Thundurus was used alongside Landorus to attack [[Zinzolin]] at the [[Cold Storage]]. When {{adv|Blake}} arrived in the area, he found Zinzolin, unconscious and defeated, along with Thundurus and Landorus. When Thundurus and Landorus spotted Blake, they changed into their Therian Formes. Blake had his {{p|Kabutops|Kabutott}} battle against Thundurus while he chased after Colress. [[PS541|Soon after]], Thundurus defeated the Shellfish Pokémon. In ''[[PS545|Deduction Time]]'', Thundurus is sent out by the Shadow Triad alongside Tornadus and Landorus to fight the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}. Thundurus is incredibly fast, said to be able to fly from corner to corner of [[Unova]] in just one day. Landorus
